I built the lower third as a 6 s piece on a blue-grey backdrop. The panel is translucent, the name and title reveal inside their own soft masks, and everything is clear by 5.8 s.

- **Accent line** (`Accent line`): extends left to right along the top edge of the panel, 0.2–1.1 s.
- **Panel** (`Panel`): slides in 40 px from the left and fades up, 0.6–1.5 s. It's a dark blue-grey at 72% opacity with 6 px corners.
- **Name** (`Name`, "Dr. Amelia Hart"): rises 50 px out of a clip mask, 1.0–1.9 s.
- **Title** (`Title`, "Head of Research, Larkspur Labs"): rises 30 px out of its own mask, 1.25–2.15 s, so it trails the name.
- **Hold:** about 2.2 s of full readability before the out.
- **Out:** the text fades up and away (4.6–5.0 s), the panel slides left and fades (5.0–5.5 s), and the accent line retracts (5.3–5.8 s).

All entrances and exits use Quart In Out or Quart In, as you asked for long, calm curves with no bounce.
